meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 它会召唤5个互相敌对的AI角色——怀疑者、验证者、研究者、架构师、创意者——先让它们互相攻击彼此的想法,只留下扛得住批评的结论,再把结论交给专门的 plan 智能体写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 你提到 hyperplan、hpp、/hyperplan 等触发词,或要求做对抗式、敌对式、交叉批评式规划时触发。前提:已开启 team 模式,由 sisyphus 主持并在主会话运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 给我的项目做一次对抗式规划。
say.note: 启动5个互相批评的角色轮流攻击方案。

say.text: hpp: 找出我发布计划里的薄弱假设和盲点。
say.note: 验证者、研究者等会从集成、证据角度挑刺。

say.text: /hyperplan 检查这个方案是不是过度设计了。
say.note: 怀疑者会专门攻击多余复杂度。

howto.what_en: Spawns 5 hostile AI roles — skeptic, validator, researcher, architect, creative — to attack each other's ideas. Only insights that survive the debate are kept, then handed to the 'plan' agent to become an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan' or asking for adversarial, hostile, or cross-critique planning. Requires team mode on, running as sisyphus (or a lead-eligible agent) in the main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to run an adversarial plan for my project.
hpp: find weak assumptions and blind spots in my release plan.
say_en.note: Validator and researcher probe integration and evidence.

say_en.text: /hyperplan check if this proposal is over-engineered.
